## Sophia modules (sophia.html) · 2 passages

- **ep**: Maria Farmer, an artist working for Epstein as an art scout, reported him to the New York Police Department on August 29, 1996, and was advised to contact the FBI. On September 3, 1996 the Bureau logged the case and classified it as child pornography, because nude and semi-nude photographs of minors existed. The complaint states that she was a professional artist who had taken pictures of her sisters, aged 12 and 16, for her own artwork; that Epstein stole the photographs and was believed to have sold them; that he had asked her to photograph young girls at swimming pools; and that he threatened to burn her house down if she told anyone.
